slides.text:
Your system drive is under 15% free
A full drive crawls no matter how new the PC is.
WHY IT'S A PROBLEM — A full drive crawls no matter how new the PC is.
THE FIX — Settings > Storage > Temporary files — clear it, then empty the Recycle Bin.

posts.title: More VRAM is all that matters

slides.text: More VRAM is all that matters
THE TRUTH — Memory bandwidth, the cooler and sustained TGP matter as much as raw VRAM. A high-wattage lower-tier GPU often beats a low-power version of a higher tier.

posts.title: Get notifications under control on iPhone

slides.text:
Get notifications under control on iPhone
Settings > Notifications
Settings > Notifications
Turn off everything that isn't an actual person
Leave badges only for mail and messages
Enable Scheduled Summary for the rest
One quiet morning of work and you'll feel it.
Save this — you'll need it next time.

posts.caption:
Get notifications under control on iPhone 🍎

1. Settings > Notifications
2. Turn off everything that isn't an actual person
3. Leave badges only for mail and messages
4. Enable Scheduled Summary for the rest
5. One quiet morning of work and you'll feel it.
